The selected pages of this section cover what to do at a crash, the reporting threshold, the safety responsibility law and its filings, mandatory insurance coverages, when you can sue for injury, and the insurance law penalties; they describe crash duties and insurance obligations and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the reporting threshold, filing forms, coverage minimums and penalties are statutory amounts printed in this twenty twenty-three edition; they are stable within the printing but belong to the class of facts the legislature can change, so the dossier records them exactly as printed.
